entities.name: Kujar
entities.description: An exclusive residential district in the heart of Ghirapur, designed by elves according to the Great Conduit philosophy.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: Elven philosophy of harmony with the flow of aether on which Kujar's design is based.

entities.name: Prakhata Club
entities.description: One of Ghirapur's most exclusive social societies, hidden in Kujar and governed by an elite circle of aetherborn.

entities.name: Sakti Station
entities.description: Unremarkable stop on the Spring Line giving access to the Prakhata Club.

entities.name: Trophy Room
entities.description: Secure suite above the club's main hall displaying members' valuable devices.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Ghirapur's governing body whose high officials hold estates in Kujar.
